questions.q: Why can $|x - 7| = -3$ have no real solutions?
choices: The absolute value of any real expression is non-negative ($|u| \geq 0$), so it cannot equal a negative number
Because $-3$ is not a prime number
The equation has complex solutions only
questions.answer: By definition, $|u| \geq 0$ for all $u \in \mathbb{R}$. A non-negative quantity can never equal $-3$.

$|u| \geq a \Leftrightarrow u \leq -a$ or $u \geq a$. Branch 1: $3x + 1 \leq -10 \Rightarrow 3x \leq -11 \Rightarrow x \leq -11/3$. Branch 2: $3x + 1 \geq 10 \Rightarrow 3x \geq 9 \Rightarrow x \geq 3$.

questions.q: Which interval notation represents the solution to $|x - a| \leq \epsilon$ where $\epsilon > 0$?
questions.answer: $|x - a| \leq \epsilon \Leftrightarrow -\epsilon \leq x - a \leq \epsilon \Leftrightarrow a - \epsilon \leq x \leq a + \epsilon$, giving $[a - \epsilon, a + \epsilon]$.

questions.q: When $P(x) = 2x^3 - 3x^2 + ax - 5$ is divided by $(x - 2)$, the remainder is $11$. Find $a$.
questions.answer: By the Remainder Theorem, $P(2) = 11$. $P(2) = 2(8) - 3(4) + 2a - 5 = 16 - 12 + 2a - 5 = 2a - 1$. Setting $2a - 1 = 11 \Rightarrow 2a = 12 \Rightarrow a = 6$.

questions.q: If $(x + 3)$ is a factor of $Q(x) = x^3 + kx^2 - 7x + 6$, find $k$.
questions.answer: By the Factor Theorem, $Q(-3) = 0$. $Q(-3) = (-3)^3 + k(-3)^2 - 7(-3) + 6 = -27 + 9k + 21 + 6 = 9k$. Setting $9k = 0 \Rightarrow k = 0$.

questions.q: A polynomial $f(x)$ leaves remainder 3 when divided by $(x - 1)$ and remainder 7 when divided by $(x - 3)$. What is the linear remainder when $f(x)$ is divided by $(x - 1)(x - 3)$?
questions.answer: Let $R(x) = ax + b$. $R(1) = a + b = 3$ and $R(3) = 3a + b = 7$. Subtracting: $2a = 4 \Rightarrow a = 2$. Then $b = 3 - 2 = 1$. The remainder is $2x + 1$.

questions.q: How is the graph of $y = |f(x)|$ obtained from the graph of $y = f(x)$?
choices: Any part of the graph lying below the $x$-axis is reflected vertically across the $x$-axis into the upper half-plane
The left half of the graph is discarded and replaced by reflection of the right half
The graph is shifted 1 unit upward
The graph is reflected across the $y$-axis
questions.answer: Taking $|f(x)|$ preserves positive $y$-values and takes the opposite of negative $y$-values, reflecting sections below the $x$-axis upward across the $x$-axis.

questions.q: How is the graph of $y = f(|x|)$ obtained from $y = f(x)$?
choices: Discard the portion for $x < 0$, and reflect the portion for $x \geq 0$ across the $y$-axis to form an even function
Reflect the entire graph across the $x$-axis
Shift the graph to the right by $|x|$
questions.answer: Because $|-x| = |x|$, $f(|x|)$ is an even function: the right half ($x \geq 0$) is reflected across the $y$-axis, discarding the original $x < 0$ part.

questions.q: What is the vertex (sharp turn) of the function $g(x) = 3|x - 4| - 5$?
questions.answer: The absolute value term $|x - 4|$ reaches its minimum of 0 at $x = 4$. At $x = 4$, $g(4) = 0 - 5 = -5$, giving vertex $(4, -5)$.
